notes.title: Steam Scream Fest 3D - Scholar's Mate is on sale!
notes.content:
[h3]A chilling first-person Escape Room awaits you in Scholar's Mate at the abandoned hospital!
[/h3]

During this new Steam Scream Fest 3D, you can grab Scholar's Mate and save 25% and enjoy a different version with the spooky Eddie! 🎃

Immerse yourself in a terrifying Escape Room where your captor is always lurking in the shadows! 🔪

Can you survive this horrifying night at the abandoned psychiatric hospital? 🏥

[h3]👇Buy Scholar's Mate here 👇
[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095510?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=steamscream2024&utm_medium=steamevent

[/list]
